name: deltadraw
description: DeltaDraw by submillisecond.com, as a rune for Claude Code: /deltadraw (draw a picture - a scene, an illustration, a hand-drawn sketch - as a deltadraw.submillisecond.com URL; the scene travels in the URL fragment and the viewer compiles it). Installs the hosted deltadraw MCP server (check, url, png, svg, gif, pack, to_scene, symbols, spec; prompts draw, refine), so every drawing is compiled through the real engine and looked at as a PNG before it is handed over. Without MCP, a zero-dep dd-url script builds the link offline and dd-png fetches the picture (or one frame) and dd-gif the animation over plain HTTP, on Windows and POSIX.
